"""Camera- and proprioception-guided controller for the single live episode.
No simulator imports or hidden scene data. All motion is sent through rcb_client.
Interactive commands are recorded in commands.txt; actual actions in runs/*/actions.npy.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
import json, pathlib, time
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
CAMS=list(spec['cameras'])
obs=None
counter=len(list((ROOT/'runs').glob('*'))) if (ROOT/'runs').exists() else 0

def record(o,actions=None,note='observe'):
 global obs,counter
 obs=o; counter+=1
 p=ROOT/'runs'/f'{counter:03d}_{note}'
 o.save(str(p))
 if actions is not None: np.save(p/'actions.npy',actions)
 (ROOT/'latest.txt').write_text(str(p))
 print('SAVED',p,'time_left',round(o.meta['time_left_s']), 'eef',np.round(state()[26:29],4),'q',np.round(state()[4:11],4),'finger',np.round(state()[11:13],4),flush=True)
 return o

def state(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def observe(seconds=0): return record(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,seconds=seconds,video='none'))
def send(A,note='move'):
 return record(r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none',note=note),A,note)
def moveq(q,seconds=1.5,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,note='joint'):
 s=state(); n=max(1,round(seconds/.05)); a=np.zeros((n,13)); a[:,:7]=np.linspace(s[4:11],q,n); a[:,7]=s[36] if grip is None else grip
 if base is not None: a[:,8:11]=base
 a[:,11]=torso; a[:,12]=mode
 return send(a,note)
def hold(seconds=.5,grip=None): return moveq(state()[4:11],seconds,grip,note='hold')
def point(u,v,cam='robot0_eye_in_hand',radius=0):
 c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']); d=obs.depth[cam].squeeze()
 z=float(np.median(d[max(0,v-radius):v+radius+1,max(0,u-radius):u+radius+1])); p=T[:3,:3]@([((u-K[0,2])/K[0,0])*z,-((v-K[1,2])/K[1,1])*z,-z])+T[:3,3]
 print('POINT',u,v,np.round(p,5),'depth',z);return p

def rx(a):return Rotation.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix()
def rz(a):return Rotation.from_euler('z',a).as_matrix()
origins=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,(xyz,a) in zip(q,origins):
  X=np.eye(4);X[:3,:3]=rx(a)@rz(qi);X[:3,3]=xyz;T=T@X
 return T
samples=[]
def sample():
 s=state(); samples.append((s[4:11],s[26:29],np.array(obs.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3])); return len(samples)
model=None

def fit():
 global model
 def residual(x):
  B=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();t=x[3:6];e=x[6:9];C=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[9:12]).as_matrix();res=[]
  for q,p,R in samples:
   T=fk(q); res.extend((B@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@e)+t-p)*5);res.extend(Rotation.from_matrix((B@T[:3,:3]@C).T@R).as_rotvec())
  return res
 x=np.r_[[0,0,np.pi],[2.7,-2,1],[0,0,.2],[np.pi,0,0]]
 sol=least_squares(residual,x,max_nfev=2000,ftol=1e-13,xtol=1e-13,gtol=1e-13)
 model=sol.x;np.save(ROOT/'kinematic_model.npy',model)
 print('FIT',np.linalg.norm(sol.fun),model)
 return sol

def predict(q):
 x=model;B=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();T=fk(q)
 return B@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@x[6:9])+x[3:6],B@T[:3,:3]@Rotation.from_rotvec(x[9:12]).as_matrix()
def ik(p,R=None,q0=None):
 if q0 is None:q0=state()[4:11]
 if R is None:R=np.array(obs.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
 def fun(q):
  pp,RR=predict(q)
  return np.r_[(pp-p)*6,Rotation.from_matrix(RR.T@R).as_rotvec(),(q-q0)*.008]
 sol=least_squares(fun,q0,bounds=([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.06,-2.89,-.017,-2.89],[2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89]),max_nfev=200)
 pp,RR=predict(sol.x);print('IK',np.round(sol.x,4),'err',np.round(pp-p,5), 'rot',np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(RR.T@R).as_rotvec()))
 if np.linalg.norm(pp-p)>.02:raise ValueError('unreachable')
 return sol.x

def movep(p,R=None,seconds=2,grip=None,note='cartesian'):
 q=ik(np.array(p),R);return moveq(q,seconds,grip,note=note)
DOWN=np.array([[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1.]])

def shift_model():
 """After moving the base, use the unchanged joint posture to update its transform."""
 global model
 s=state();p,RR=predict(s[4:11]);Rnow=np.array(obs.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3];D=Rnow@RR.T
 B=Rotation.from_rotvec(model[:3]).as_matrix();model[:3]=Rotation.from_matrix(D@B).as_rotvec();model[3:6]=s[26:29]+D@(model[3:6]-p)
 np.save(ROOT/'kinematic_model.npy',model)

if __name__=='__main__':
 observe()
 import code,readline,atexit
 hist=ROOT/'commands.txt'
 if hist.exists():readline.read_history_file(str(hist))
 atexit.register(readline.write_history_file,str(hist))
 code.interact(local=globals())
PY
